summary: Eastern International Ltd. filed a 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq notification dated September 10, 2026, stating its ordinary shares (NASDAQ: ELOG) closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive trading days, breaching Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2). The deficiency has no immediate listing effect; the company has until March 9, 2027 (180-day Compliance Period) to regain compliance by closing at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. A further 180-day extension may be available, contingent on meeting market value and initial listing standards, possibly via reverse split. Watch for reverse-split or delisting risk-arb dynamics.
